faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How is UpNext different from other platforms?
faq.a1: UpNext focuses on your current moment: how you feel and how much attention you can dedicate right now. It doesn't show you infinite lists, but rather few well-chosen recommendations that fit your mood and attention level at this specific moment.
faq.a2: No, UpNext doesn't decide for you. It shows you recommendations based on your tastes and your current moment, but you always have control. You can change your mood and attention level whenever you want, and the recommendations will adjust.
faq.q3: Do I have to create lists?
faq.a3: You don't need to create lists. UpNext works with your preferences (movies and TV shows you like) and your current moment. You can save titles for later if you want, but it's not required.
faq.q4: Can I change my attention level whenever I want?
faq.a4: Yes, you can change your mood and attention level at any time. The recommendations will update automatically to reflect your new moment.

howItWorks.title: How UpNext works
howItWorks.description: Discover how UpNext helps you find the perfect content to watch on streaming.
howItWorks.whatIsDescription1: UpNext is an intelligent platform that helps you discover perfect movies and TV shows for you. Instead of wasting time searching for what to watch, we recommend personalized content based on your tastes and preferences.
howItWorks.whatIsDescription2: We also show you which streaming platforms each title is available on, so you know exactly where to watch it.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about UpNext.
faq.q1: How does the recommendation system work?
faq.a1: Our algorithm analyzes your preferences based on the movies and TV shows you select, titles you mark as seen, ones you add to favorites, and ones you save. It also considers your mood and attention level to offer you personalized recommendations that adapt to how you feel at each moment.
faq.q2: Do I need to create an account to use UpNext?
faq.a2: Yes, you need to create a free account to use UpNext. This allows us to save your preferences and offer you personalized recommendations. Your information is protected and we never share your data with third parties.
faq.q3: Where do you get information about streaming availability?
faq.a3: We use The Movie Database (TMDB) API to get updated information about which platforms each title is available on. This information is updated regularly, but keep in mind that availability may vary based on your geographic location.
faq.q4: Can I change my preferences after the initial onboarding?
faq.a4: Yes, you can update your preferences at any time. Every time you mark a title as seen, add it to favorites, save it for later, or mark it as not interested, the system learns and automatically adjusts your recommendations. You can also search for specific content and explore different genres.
faq.q5: What's the difference between "Favorites" and "Watch later"?
faq.a5: "Favorites" is used to add content you've already seen and enjoyed, helping the system understand your preferences. "Watchlist" is for content you haven't seen yet but want to remember to watch in the future. Both help improve your recommendations, but serve different purposes.
faq.q6: Why don't I see all available streaming platforms?
faq.a6: Content availability on streaming platforms varies based on your geographic location. We show platforms available in your region based on TMDB data. If you don't see a specific platform, it may be that the content isn't available in your country or the information hasn't been updated yet.
faq.q7: How can I delete my account?
faq.a7: You can delete your account at any time from the profile page. When you delete your account, all your data will be deleted, including your preferences, lists, and history. This action cannot be undone. If you need help, you can contact us at hello{'@'}getupnext.io.
faq.a8: Yes, UpNext is completely free. We don't charge for using the platform or for recommendations. Our goal is to help you find content you enjoy at no cost.
faq.q9: Can I use UpNext on my mobile?
faq.a9: Yes, UpNext is a responsive web application that works perfectly on mobile devices, tablets, and computers. You can access it from any browser on your mobile device and enjoy all the features.
faq.q10: What should I do if I find an error or have a suggestion?
faq.a10: We'd love to hear your feedback. You can contact us at hello{'@'}getupnext.io with any errors you find, improvement suggestions, or questions not answered in this section. Your feedback helps us continuously improve UpNext.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: At UpNext we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.dataCollectionDescription: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your email address, content preferences, and activity on the platform.
privacy.dataUsageDescription: We use the collected information to provide you with personalized recommendations, improve our services, and communicate with you when necessary.
privacy.cookiesWhatAreDescription: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. These cookies allow the website to remember your actions and preferences for a period of time, so you don't have to reconfigure them every time you return to the site or navigate from one page to another.
privacy.cookiesTechnicalDescription: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They enable basic functions such as secure navigation and access to protected areas of the site.
privacy.cookiesTechnicalNote: Important: These technical cookies are always active, even if you reject the use of cookies, as they are necessary for the proper functioning of the platform.
privacy.cookiesTechnicalItem3: YouTube video playback (necessary for video functionality)
privacy.cookiesPreferencesDescription: These cookies allow the website to remember information that changes how the site behaves or looks, such as your preferred language or the region you're in.
privacy.cookiesListDescription: Below is a complete list of all cookies, localStorage data, and sessionStorage data we use on our website:
privacy.cookieI18nPurpose: Stores your language preference to remember the selected language on future visits.
privacy.cookieSupabasePurpose: Manages user authentication session and enables secure access to protected areas of the site.
privacy.cookieConsentPurpose: Stores your cookie consent preference (accepted or rejected).
privacy.cookieThemePurpose: Stores your visual theme preference (light or dark mode).
privacy.cookieThemeManualPurpose: Indicates whether you have manually set a theme preference, rather than using automatic system detection.
privacy.cookieAuthRecoveryPurpose: Temporary flag used during the password recovery flow to prevent incorrect authentication states.
privacy.cookiePreviousRoutePurpose: Stores the previous route to enable back navigation from detail pages.
privacy.cookieGeneratingRecommendationsPurpose: Indicates when recommendations are being generated to prevent duplicate requests.
privacy.cookieYouTubePurpose: Video playback functionality (necessary for displaying trailers and recaps)
privacy.cookiesManagementDescription: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie banner that appears when you first visit our site. You can accept or reject preference cookies, but keep in mind that technical cookies will always be active.
privacy.cookiesManagementNote: If you reject preference cookies, some site features may not be available or may not work correctly.
